svg.text: One clip, filmed down the line. AIcoach checks the video before it analyses anything.
mp4 or mov, up to 15 seconds, one swing

text.tspan: If you switch this on, your swing clip is stored on the AIcoach server until
you delete it. If it stays off, the clip is deleted as soon as the analysis is
finished. Your result is kept either way.

svg.text: From behind, along the target line
Tripod, or propped on your bag
Head to feet, club at the top
Measuring how far your hips move toward the ball and how much your posture angle changes, from address to impact.
If the clip turns out to be unusable, AIcoach stops here and shows you why. It never guesses from a bad video.
